instrument.retentionNote: sliding window (oldest evicted); full 2010-request run un-evicted; snapshot exposes cap
instrument.shardingSphereWiringNotes: 5.4.1 strips dataSourceClassName key only for the literal HikariDataSource class name, so the key is bound as a custom prop for other classes; wrapper deliberately exposes no setDataSourceClassName (silently skipped) and is a plain DataSource owning an inner real HikariDataSource, avoiding the HikariCP dataSourceClassName delegate branch that applies MySQL default query props (netTimeoutForStreamingResults removed in HikariCP 5.x -> RuntimeException). Pool metadata TypedSPI registered so standard 'url' normalizes from yaml jdbcUrl; getters must pair with setters because StorageUnit reflects username/password back from the instance.

mavenGate.deltaVsTask139: +9 (SubmitTxTimingTest 5, SPI wiring 2, submit wiring 1, main-yaml pool-class 1)

nextSingleHypothesis: submit latency is dominated by physical connection acquisition wait (measured P50 527ms) produced by pool-10 queuing over in-tx work (track multi-row INSERT ~20ms + commit interval ~25ms); further work should shrink in-tx work (track write or commit interval) and re-measure on the connWait baseline, not blind-tune pool size or flush settings
